description: A reversal and a reversal back (dark, light, dark theme) learned in conversation, then the current and the earlier value. Limit: the duplicate check can swallow the return to a value stated before, and a replaced value is never supplied for an earlier-value question. Failure means: the current probe failing is an update defect, the earlier probe failing is the known absence of history recall. Maintenance: meaningful both ways; with maintenance on the superseded record is expected to be deleted (the earlier-value probe fails for that reason), with --no-maintenance it shows whether retrieval could answer at all.
